NOBILITY_obinutuzumab_wk104.warning: target class separated late in NOBILITY/BLISS-LN; a week-24 read-out may understate the 1-year effect

_rule: Frozen 2026-11-21 before reading published week-104 CRR. Target: log OR of CRR at week 104 (drug vs placebo) from the peer-reviewed extension papers (NOBILITY: Furie 2022 Ann Rheum Dis; TULIP-LN: Jayne 2023 Ann Rheum Dis, PMID 37607780). Baselines scored alongside: null (0) and carry-forward of the week-52 log OR. Pass = truth inside forecaster 95% interval for all three, and forecaster squared error <= carry-forward on average.
